findings.problem: Invoice KITM20157 (4 Sep 2026, PKR 238,000) is not in data/weekly/2026-11-23.csv. Crescent Health Services has only three open invoices on the sheet: KITM20305, KITM20401 and KITM20402.

The Total row (1,225,500) does not equal the sum of the rows above it. As written, those rows add up to 1,481,500. The rules say the total must equal the sum of the table rows. 1,225,500 is the correct total from the sheet, so the table rows are what is wrong.

findings.problem: "Pay within 24 hours or we will take legal action." is a legal threat and an ultimatum. Both brand/voice.md and the reminder rules forbid any mention of legal action. It is also not polite.
findings.fix: Delete this line. Line 17 already makes the request.
